articles.summary: Hafnia has been named Tanker Operator of the Year at the 24th ShipTek International Awards Singapore 2026, winning the award for the second consecutive year. articles.title: Hafnia Wins Tanker Operator of the Year at ShipTek Singapore 2026 for the Second Consecutive Year
